## bulkDeleteDocuments

Bulk Delete Documents. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/bulk-delete`

Queue async deletion for many documents at once.

Transactional safety: rows are flipped to status='deleting' in a single transaction, then one kb_delete_file Pub/Sub message is published per document. If publishing fails mid-batch, we revert all affected rows back to status='ready' and return 500.

Modes: - existing_pages: Re-crawl the exact URLs from previous crawl history (faster, predictable scope) - full_rescan: Re-discover pages via sitemap/BFS from scratch (finds new pages, more thorough)


|---|---|---|---|
| `$historyId` | `string` | yes | ID of the crawl history record to use for re-crawling |
| `$mode` | `?string` | no | Recrawl mode. Defaults to 'full_rescan', which re-discovers pages from scratch via sitemap/BFS and picks up newly added pages. 'existing_pages' re-crawls only the URLs stored from the previous crawl. |
| `$titlePrefix` | `?string` | no | Optional prefix for document titles |
| `$pageLimit` | `?int` | no | Maximum pages to crawl (1-2000). If omitted, the coordinator falls back to its default page limit. |
| `$clearExisting` | `?bool` | no | Hard reset. When True, the existing documents for this domain (and their RAG corpus files) are deleted BEFORE the re-crawl runs, then pages are re-discovered and re-imported from scratch. ## uploadMultipleDocuments

Upload Multiple Documents. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/upload-multiple`

Upload multiple files at once to the knowledge base.

Up to 200 files per request. Each file is uploaded to GCS, gets its own status='pending_ingestion' DB row + job_id, and is dispatched to the KB administration worker as an independent kb_add_file Pub/Sub message. ## putDocumentRaw

Put Document Raw. `PUT /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/raw`

Replace the raw text content of an editable KB document.

Behaviour: 1. Validates size (≤ 1 MB) — returns 413 otherwise. 2. Validates that the document type + extension are editable (otherwise 400, same rules as GET /raw). 3. Uploads the new bytes to GCS (same path pattern as upload_to_gcs() — rag_uploads/{tenant_id}/doc_{id}_{uuid}.{ext}). 4. Updates the DB row: gemini_file_name / upload_metadata.gcs_uri point at the new blob, status → pending_ingestion, a fresh job_id is set, updated_at = utc_now(). 5. Publishes a kb_add_file message to PUBSUB_TOPIC_KB_ADMINISTRATION so the KB administration worker performs the Vertex AI RAG import. When ingestion completes, status transitions back to ready.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->putDocumentRaw(documentId: 'document_id', content: 'content');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$content` | `string` | yes | New UTF-8 text content (max 1 MB) |

Returns `KnowledgeBaseDocument`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/put_document_raw_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__raw_put)

## retryDocument

Retry Document. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/retry`

Retry ingestion for a single knowledge base document.

Retryable documents are either status='failed' OR a *stuck* status='pending_ingestion' row — one left un-imported under a crawl/ ingestion job that has since finished (see _pending_ingestion_is_stuck: old enough and owned by no still-running job). Any other status — including a pending_ingestion row whose ingestion job is still running — returns 409. The GCS object already exists from the original upload, so this does NOT re-upload the file bytes — it re-derives the gcs_uri + folder corpus from the stored metadata, flips the row to status='pending_ingestion' with a fresh job_id and last_error=NULL, and re-publishes the kb_add_file Pub/Sub message. Returns the updated document (202).

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->retryDocument(documentId: 'document_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KnowledgeBaseDocument`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/retry_document_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__retry_post)

## deleteFolder

Delete Folder. `DELETE /knowledge-base/folders/{folder_id}`

Queue async deletion for a folder and all of its documents.

## retryFailedDocumentsInFolder

Retry Failed Documents In Folder. `POST /knowledge-base/folders/{folder_id}/retry-failed`

Retry every failed document in a folder.

Re-queues every retryable document in the folder using the same per-document logic as the single retry endpoint: all status='failed' documents, plus any status='pending_ingestion' document that is *stuck* — left un-imported under a crawl/ingestion job that has since finished (see _pending_ingestion_is_stuck). A pending_ingestion row still owned by a running job is skipped, never re-queued. A folder with nothing to retry is not an error — it returns retried_count: 0.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->retryFailedDocumentsInFolder(folderId: 'folder_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RetryFailed`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/retry_failed_documents_in_folder_api_v1_knowledge_base_folders__folder_id__retry_failed_post)
